name: Speeder
summary: Fast offshore powerboat confirmed in Keys and Vice City waterway chase scenes. Top water speed makes it the smuggler vessel of choice in Leonida.
description: The Shitzu Speeder is an offshore racing powerboat inspired by classic cigarette boats. Confirmed in Keys archipelago and Vice City waterway chase sequences, its twin high-output engines deliver unmatched water speed, making it the preferred vessel for contraband runners and smugglers operating across Leonida's extensive coastline. It handles choppy open water with ease.

seo.title: Speeder Boat: Specs & Locations
seo.description: Full profile of the Shitzu Speeder in GTA VI. Top speed, handling on water, and locations for Leonida's fastest offshore powerboat.
